critique: Three passes. The full-width gold 'Collect 3.4k' button above the experience bar is the largest and lightest control in grayscale and catches the eye first; the island name pills, the currency strip and the Islands/Heist tabs are smaller or darker and fall in behind it.

Three passes. The keeper portrait in the gold ring beside 'Keeper 24' is larger than the pass anchor's crew portraits, with a readable face, a dark outline and a wand, in soft stepped toon fills with no photographic grain or sheen, and it reads in grayscale. Judged from the 960 px still; no crop was supplied. The island figures were left out as world.
